races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Joga Bonito
runners_data.spotlight: Made 85,000gns as a yearling; closely related to Group-placed 1m/1m1f winner Silver Sword (RPR 106), half-brother to winners Ae Fond Kiss (7.3f; 67) and Mister Slovakia (Polish 9.5f); dam 2m AW winner (90); joint favourite, showed plenty of speed but green (hung left) and weakened inside final furlong on recent Roscommon debut over 7.5f; drop back in trip should suit.

runners_data.name: Citrus Springs
runners_data.spotlight: Olympiad filly cost 65,000USD as a yearling and 300,000USD at the breeze-ups; half-sister to US winners Spirit Maker (1m-1m1f turf inc 2yo) and Not Guilty (5f AW); dam once-raced half-sister to US 8.5f Grade 2 winner Protonico, is granddaughter of US 8.5f Grade 1 winner Wild Spirit; very interesting debutante, likely has ground to suit (holds Group entry next month).

runners_data.name: Pisiffik Ginger
runners_data.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly cost 22,000euros as a foal; first foal; dam 1m winner (RPR 90), half-sister to 1m3f/12.4f winner Sportingsilvermine; market best guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Magical Moonlight
runners_data.spotlight: Invincible Army filly cost 12,000euros as a yearling; half-sister to Italian 6f winner Nalu; dam Group-placed 6f 2yo winner (RPR 96), closely related to 5.5f 2yo winner Miss Rosina; yard having a good season so respected but but juveniles tend to benefit from a run.

runners_data.name: Tatianna
runners_data.spotlight: Kameko filly; 20,000euros foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Qaroun (useful 7f/1m) and Puerto De Vega (6f/7f); encouraging debut in similar 5f race at Cork nine days ago but plenty more likely needed here.

runners_data.name: I Ready
runners_data.spotlight: Invincible Army gelding; 10,000euros yearling; second foal; dam runner-up 6f 2yo (RPR 74), half-sister to winners Insignia Of Rank (1m Listed) and Mayleaf Shine (useful 5f inc 2yo); slow to break and green, not disgraced in the circumstances on Curragh debut last Saturday; quick return and should have learnt a lot.

runners_data.name: Lars Soldier
runners_data.comment: Hugely improved over debut when beating Edward Thatch last time; unraced on better ground
runners_data.spotlight: All three runs have been at the Curragh, big improvement second occasion to beat two subsequent winners in 5f maiden on testing ground; upped to 6f in Group 3 Marble Hill on Sunday, not doing himself justice on quicker ground after racing keenly when beaten over 6l; persisted with at this trip, needs to settle better.

runners_data.name: High King
runners_data.spotlight: Calyx colt; price rose from 55,000euros as a foal to 150,000gns as a yearling; closely related to 7f 2yo winner Look Around (inc Listed; RPR 105), half-brother to four winners inc Sara Lucille (French Group-placed 5f inc 2yo; 100); dam 2yo Group 3 winner; 10/1, green when never sighted on debut in Curragh maiden early this month; sure to come on from that.

runners_data.name: Granite Mountain
runners_data.spotlight: Last of 7 on Curragh debut on opening day of the season in testing conditions; best watched.

races.name: Royal County Optional Claiming Race

runners_data.name: Tawaazon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 307-day layoff but previous course winner with solid form figures on similar going
runners_data.spotlight: Durable sort; gained the most recent of his nine wins at Naas a year ago before good third at the Curragh; absent since July and looks to have a bit to find with some of these.

runners_data.name: Gloriously Glam
runners_data.note: Natural leader coming off Gowran success eight days ago, will set uncontested pace under Adam Caffrey
runners_data.spotlight: Was gaining a fourth career win when landing similar 7f contest at Gowran eight days ago, beating Profit Surge a shade cosily; similar terms with that rival here but shorter trip a slight concern.

runners_data.name: Three Sixteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 268-day break for new yard, hooded first-time and prone to finishing fade
runners_data.spotlight: Given a mark of 67 after three maiden runs in second half of last season over different trips; hooded on return for new yard.

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Eagles
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner carrying bottom weight off recent Sligo placed effort, sole win came three years ago
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came over 5f at Down Royal three years ago; best run for some time when placed in Sligo handicap early this month off basement mark of 40; plenty on at the weights against most of her rivals here.

runners_data.name: Mehmar
runners_data.note: Prominent sort who won twice over this trip in 2024, suited by good ground but generally regressing
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over this trip for Michael O'Callaghan on turf in 2024, showing a liking for quick ground; placed in AW claimer over the winter but generally regressive; visor replaces cheekpieces here and looks to have something to find.

runners_data.name: Profit Surge
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who pushed Gloriously Glam close at Gowran eight days ago, meets that rival on similar terms
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden was placed three times in AW handicaps last winter and ran well above her handicap mark when pushing Gloriously Glam close in 7f Gowran claimer eight days ago, albeit when allowed to dictate a steady pace; handicap mark has gone up 9lb but meets that rival on same terms here; blinkers now tried and drops in trip.

runners_data.name: Lismacbryan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner prone to fading finish, sole win came over this trip but poor recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win came over this trip in Curragh handicap in 2024; good second in first-time cheekpieces at Naas last summer but little since; would be much better off with all of these in a handicap.

races.paceDynamic: Gloriously Glam will take the early lead unopposed, with Tawaazon, Mehmar, and Lismacbryan settling prominently behind. The pace will be modest and sustainable given the single confirmed front-runner with no serious pressure from prominent racers content to track. Three Sixteen, Spirit Of Eagles, and Profit Surge will drop out the back, creating a patient hold-up contingent. This setup strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and kick clear, as the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Gloriously Glam sets uncontested fractions allowing prominent horses to pounce
scenarios.body: The modest pace plays perfectly into the hands of Tawaazon and Mehmar who can sit close and unleash superior finishing kicks. Hold-up horses struggle to make ground from the back with insufficient pace collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Gloriously Glam capitalizes on her recent Gowran success and sustains her kick to the line
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds enough cushion through steady fractions to hold off late challenges from prominent trackers. Recent winner's confidence and fitness edge proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves faster than expected with prominent horses applying unexpected pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for Three Sixteen and Profit Surge to produce telling late runs. Spirit Of Eagles benefits from his recent Sligo placing with strong closing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely into a sprint finish favoring pure speed over positioning
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash where basement-rated Spirit Of Eagles or returning Three Sixteen find career-best form. Class differentials evaporate in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Gloriously Glam breaks slowly or faces early pressure from Lismacbryan disrupting the expected uncontested lead
Tawaazon shows signs of rustiness in early stages after 307-day absence despite previous course success
Three Sixteen settles closer than expected given new headgear and yard change, potentially altering pace dynamics
Colin Keane's tactics on Profit Surge whether he drops her further back or tracks closer given recent Gowran proximity
Mehmar's early positioning under 7lb claimer Reese Holohan to gauge if connections expect improved effort

races.name: Fiver Fridays At Fairyhouse June 5th And 12th Handicap

runners_data.name: Treasured Royal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with best recent form but faces traffic problems in crowded pack
runners_data.spotlight: Navan maiden winner last season; highly tried to no avail afterwards; poor seasonal return at Naas but back on song in second handicap start in first-time hood (retained) at that venue on latest (6f, good); should give another good account off 1lb higher.

runners_data.name: All Hail
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 319 days off and noted for fading finishes creates stamina doubts
runners_data.spotlight: Second runner for stable; no impact in first two maidens but much more like it when a 2l second at Navan (6f, good) when last seen last July; gelded since and returns for handicap debut with yard amongst winners; check market.

runners_data.name: Jackie Jump Up
runners_data.note: Prominent runner making handicap debut on unfavorable good ground with new headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debutante yet to encounter good ground; 2l to find with Baiana on Sligo running latest; hood (ran well in one before) and tongue tie added; in the mix if handles quicker conditions.

runners_data.name: Baiana
runners_data.note: Prominent style with maiden win momentum but stepping up significantly in class
runners_data.spotlight: Promising effort on second start at Navan (6f, soft) last October; returned to win a Sligo fillies' maiden (6f, yld-sft) 25 days ago; could go well on handicap debut but good ground is a query.

runners_data.name: Reimagined
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fading finish tendency and 55 days since disappointing return
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Windsor maiden (6f, good) for Eve Johnson-Houghton; never involved on debut for this yard at the Curragh (6f, sft-hvy); 8lb lower now and these conditions more suitable; new headgear combination goes on.

runners_data.name: Absoluteassignment
runners_data.note: Lone leader getting first chance at front-running with tongue-tie addition
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debutant; huge odds and no show in three 7f maidens on easy ground; best watched in first-time tongue tie.

runners_data.name: Gonna Be Golden
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from strong stable but disappointed badly on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: One of two for yard; Dundalk maiden win in December (7f); tailed off on seasonal return and handicap debut at the Curragh last month (1m, soft); could improve plenty for quicker ground and drop to 6f and yard in form.

runners_data.name: Girl Bear
runners_data.note: Prominent style with positive Roscommon run but drawn into the traffic zone
runners_data.spotlight: Close third on debut at Galway last August (7f, soft); promising effort on handicap debut under positive ride at Roscommon last month (7.5f, good); eased 1lb and this shorter trip could suit; in the mix.

runners_data.name: Jampa Ling
runners_data.note: Pure hold-up horse with fading finish concerns but gets tactical advantage here
runners_data.spotlight: Well-backed when off the mark at third attempt in 6f Dundalk maiden in February; has come up short in two handicaps at 5f-6f back there since; handicapper giving him a chance and blinkers go on but others make more appeal.

runners_data.name: Stone Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up style perfectly suited to this pace setup despite 3lb claimer aboard
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have come on the AW, including over 6f on penultimate; ran on well for a 1l third of 16 off this mark at Naas on latest (5f, good); step back up to 6f a big positive; this a tougher race but looks progressive and leading claims.

races.paceDynamic: Absoluteassignment will lead uncontested from the gates with no other genuine front runners in this field. Six horses (Treasured Royal, All Hail, Jackie Jump Up, Baiana, Reimagined, Gonna Be Golden, Girl Bear) will cluster prominently behind the leader, creating a wall of horses that will compress and battle for position from 3f out. The pace will be steady early but turn into a cavalry charge when the prominent pack accelerates together. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can avoid the prominent traffic and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets into a pace battle from 3f out
scenarios.body: The early bunch kick lumps out of each other while Jampa Ling and Stone Bear get clear runs to sweep past tired leaders. The late runners benefit from both the strong pace and clean passages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent speed holds
scenarios.trigger: If Treasured Royal or Baiana can break clear from the pack
scenarios.body: One of the classier prominent runners gets first run on the field and holds off the late challenge. Their superior class tells in the final furlong despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lone leader lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Absoluteassignment gets uncontested fractions and the prominent pack waits too long
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field plays into his hands by waiting. By the time they wind up, the damage is done.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses all wait on each other through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where the first horse to commit wins. Positioning becomes more important than stamina or class.

watchPoints.text: Treasured Royal and Baiana clash for the same prominent position and compromise each other's chances
Absoluteassignment builds too big a lead if the prominent pack gets into an early speed battle
Stone Bear needs Siobhan Rutledge to time her challenge perfectly from the back
All Hail's 319-day absence shows when the pace quickens in the final 2f
Jampa Ling requires a strong pace to set up his finishing kick from the rear

races.name: 5 Euro General Admission Next Friday Handicap

runners_data.name: Are You In Or Out
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 224 days but won first time out last year, dangerous if market support emerges
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins for Paul Stafford last season, including over C&D (gd-yld) off 6lb lower; lacks a run but won first time out last year; worth market check on debut for new yard.

runners_data.name: El Fontenaro
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner best over 5f, recent comeback at Sligo wasn't devoid of merit despite maiden status
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden is 0-14 on turf; best efforts have come over 5f; beaten 0.5l off 13lb higher at Down Royal in May 2025 and comeback at Sligo (6f, yld-sft) was not devoid of promise (denied clear run); eased 2lb; not discounted if backing that up.

runners_data.name: Son Of Wind
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner dropped 6lb after heavy defeat, hasn't looked a winner in waiting for current stable
runners_data.spotlight: 5f AW winner in Britain in August 2024; failed to fire in 2025 and hasn't looked a winner in waiting in three runs for this stable; dropped 6lb for heavy defeat at Gowran latest (1m, gd-yld); can only watch down in trip.

runners_data.name: Rodeeve
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency, best over 7f on good/soft ground, 3lb claimer aboard
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden whose best efforts have come over 7f on good and soft ground; weakened into a 4.75l fourth under positive ride at Gowran latest (7f, soft); well worth a go at this trip on that evidence and dropped 3lb; could go well.

runners_data.name: Miqdaad
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency, returning after 294 days, won on AW in 2024 but one good turf run
runners_data.spotlight: AW maiden winner in 2024; one good run last year, a 0.5l second of 13 at Limerick in July; 2lb lower here but has been off since a below par run at Leopardstown last August; might need this.

runners_data.name: Happy Henry
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner knocking on the door this season, visor returns after wearing it at Sligo
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden has been knocking on the door this season; narrow defeat at Sligo on penultimate and beaten 2l when third of 17 at Naas latest; visor worn at Sligo returns and just 1lb higher here but best form on soft ground.

runners_data.name: Run Forrest Run
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner on debut for new yard, losing run since October 2024, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Knows how to win (6-44 on turf) but losing run stretches back to October 2024; in poor form on AW when last seen in December; best watched on debut for new yard after break.

runners_data.name: Verhoyen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with fading tendency, 11-year-old veteran vulnerable to younger legs at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Likeable veteran whose last four wins have come over 7f; not a bad run at Gowran latest and on dangerous mark but probably vulnerable to younger legs at this trip.

runners_data.name: Green Icon
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency, new blinkers need to transform poor 2025 form
runners_data.spotlight: Won two for Owen Burrows in 2024 but no joy yet for this stable; poor form in four runs this term; new blinkers need to transform.

runners_data.name: Twotolose
runners_data.note: Prominent runner dropping back in trip after modest 7f effort, standout maiden run at Navan
runners_data.spotlight: Standout effort on second start in a Navan maiden (5f, yielding) but nowhere near that level since, including in first two handicaps; drops in trip after modest reappearance run at Leopardstown; others preferred.

runners_data.name: I'm Spartacus
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is 6-time AW winner but 0-22 on turf, shaped better than result at Curragh
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time AW winner remains a maiden on turf (0-22); has placed over C&D (good) off 3lb higher and shaped better than the bare result at the Curragh latest so not dismissed from an each-way perspective.

runners_data.name: Apache Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with Colin Keane aboard who is 2-9 for this trainer, handicapper relenting
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 5.5f at Bath in 2023 but has come up dry since; no show in three starts for this stable but handicapper relenting and Colin Keane is 2-9 for this yard.

runners_data.name: Oxford Circus
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner yet to show winning potential on turf, good debut effort hasn't been built upon
runners_data.spotlight: Good effort in 6f maiden on debut at Dundalk (6f) in February but hasn't built on that; yet to show winning potential on turf; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Dancer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 62 days, no turf win since 2022 but 5lb lower mark
runners_data.spotlight: No win on turf since 2022 but scored at Dundalk (7f) for the third time in February; poor on latest back at Dundalk (7f); 5lb lower mark on turf but has run poorly both previous starts over this C&D.

runners_data.name: Jackandthefox
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 286 days, 0-14 on turf but ran well over C&D last June
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 on turf but one of better efforts came last June when a 3.5l second over C&D off this mark; off since a below par run at Dundalk last August; might need this run.

runners_data.name: Harry Longabaugh
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front-runner in large field, dropped 3lb after poor handicap debut but may have needed that
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in maidens and beat just one rival home on handicap debut at Naas on seasonal return; may have needed that and dropped 3lb but can only watch for now.

runners_data.name: Livingston Range
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is second reserve, close second in this race last year off 4lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; 2-34 on turf; not a bad effort on seasonal return at Navan (6f, yielding); close second in this last year off 4lb higher; could go well if gets in.

runners_data.name: Whatswrongnow
runners_data.note: Prominent runner narrowly denied at Cork off 1lb higher, handles quicker ground well
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden has been running okay this season; narrowly denied off 1lb higher at Cork on latest (5f, soft); handles quicker ground; should be in the mix again back at 6f off 1lb higher.

runners_data.name: Bel Espoir
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency who is third reserve, 5lb drop not enough to tempt
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-6 and has yet to show she is capable of winning a race; beaten 8l at Navan on latest; 5lb drop not enough to tempt.

runners_data.name: Reponse Finale
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fading tendency, 6lb lower than best handicap run, had excuses for poor comeback
runners_data.spotlight: 0-14 on turf; best handicap run came last September at Cork when a 1.25l third of ten over 6f (yielding); 6lb lower now and had excuses for poor seasonal comeback latest but might prefer easier ground.

runners_data.name: Rattletheonionbag
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is first reserve, long-standing maiden better on AW than turf
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; long standing maiden who has shown her best form on the AW; beaten 6l on return to turf at Sligo latest; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: Harry Longabaugh is the only confirmed front-runner in this large field of 21, meaning he can dictate terms without early pressure. With most runners showing prominent or hold-up styles, the pace will be genuine but not frantic, allowing Harry Longabaugh to establish a comfortable rhythm. The large field will create a cavalry charge from mid-division and the rear, but the lack of early pace pressure means the tempo may not be strong enough to set up the deep closers. This race shape favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick when the pace lifts, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Longabaugh gets an easy lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and the prominent trackers arrive too late. Hold-up horses struggle with the lack of pace and get caught in traffic in the large field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine enough to soften up Harry Longabaugh but not strong enough for deep closers
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the perfect trip tracking the leader before striking in the final furlong. The moderate pace suits horses who can position handy and have a turn of foot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected or Harry Longabaugh weakens significantly
scenarios.body: The genuine pace sets up the hold-up horses who can weave through the large field. Fresh legs from the back prove decisive despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than ability. A horse with fresh conditions or returning from a break could capitalise on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Harry Longabaugh could steal this if he gets an uncontested lead in the large field with no other pace angles
Are You In Or Out needs market support to confirm fitness after 224-day absence despite past first-time-out success
Happy Henry returning to the visor that he wore when narrowly beaten at Sligo, suggesting connections expect improvement
Livingston Range is second reserve but won this race last year and showed good form on seasonal return
Several runners showing fading tendencies over longer trips may benefit from the drop back to 6f

races.name: Book Your Hospitality At Fairyhouse.ie Handicap

runners_data.name: Elly Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace collapses but recent form suggests struggle to get competitive
runners_data.spotlight: Solid placed efforts in maidens last year for Johnny Murtagh; just okay efforts in both handicaps this term, latest when didn't seem to quite get home at Roscommon (6l off Fortuity).

runners_data.name: Venetian Star
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with tactical advantage but mile trips suggest stamina doubts over 7f
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in Down Royal nursery for Johnny Murtagh and has returned with two solid efforts for current yard without convincingly staying the mile trip, at the Curragh and when weakening late at Cork, both times on soft; drop back in trip and better ground makes him a major player.

runners_data.name: Fortuity
runners_data.note: Strong recent second at Roscommon but hold-up style needs stronger early pace than likely
runners_data.spotlight: Much improved back on better ground at Roscommon recently, awkward start but plenty of speed when second to a clear-cut winner over 7.5f; mark unchanged and definite contender.

runners_data.name: Merry Blacksmith
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but too keen recently and needs to settle better
runners_data.spotlight: Too keen and didn't get home on recent handicap debut at Roscommon (7.5f); lightly raced and could still have more to offer, if settling.

runners_data.name: Thirsty Owl
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner switching from all-weather with question marks over turf form
runners_data.spotlight: Definite signs of ability in three AW starts for Gavin Cromwell; good early speed before dropping away on yard debut in Roscommon handicap earlier this month (7.5f) in first-time cheekpieces (now left off); entitled to come on for that comeback run.

runners_data.name: Royal County Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up from all-weather win with 48 days freshness concern
runners_data.spotlight: Mostly campaigned on the AW, making the breakthrough over this trip last month off 57 under today's rider; decent ground should suit and respected off 5lb higher.

runners_data.name: Lady Kelly
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with blinkers first time but modest form suggests outclassed
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden form has been modest, all three runs on much softer ground; back in trip and blinkered for handicap debut on much quicker ground so plenty of reasons for improvement.

runners_data.name: Chapel Island
runners_data.note: Long absence of 238 days makes fitness a major question mark despite handicap relief
runners_data.spotlight: Juvenile form with Michael Mulvany wasn't progressive, never competitive on handicap bow final start on soft; since joined Andy Oliver and handicapper has given him a chance.

runners_data.name: Millhone
runners_data.note: Poor recent start and hold-up style makes him vulnerable in likely tactical affair
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't lack market support but ran no sort of race after blowing the start on seasonal return in Gowran handicap early this month; caution advised.

runners_data.name: Caoilte
runners_data.note: All runs this year on all-weather so turf return brings uncertainty despite prominent style
runners_data.spotlight: All five runs this year have been on the AW, notably fair fifth to Royal County Glory over this trip, most recently last of 10 over a mile last month; return to 7f may suit for turf debut but others make greater appeal.

runners_data.name: One Cool Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form but needs pace to develop properly
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden with plenty of experience, notably twice runner-up in AW handicaps; plenty to find with Fortuity on recent Roscommon run though.

runners_data.name: Kc Bear
runners_data.note: Slow-starting pattern could prove costly if Venetian Star gets easy lead
runners_data.spotlight: Ended AW campaign winning 6f nursery in December, needing every yard after a slow start; returned to Dundalk in March when again not the best of starts, produced with every chance but just outstayed over a mile; drop back to 7f should suit and leading contender off what appears still a nice mark.

runners_data.name: Alandownunder
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor recent form and trainer out of form suggests struggle
runners_data.spotlight: Moderate form in maidens last autumn on easy ground; plenty fresh on recent seasonal return on handicap debut at Roscommon and lots to find with a couple of these on that run.

races.paceDynamic: Venetian Star will take this race on from the front with minimal pressure, as he's the only confirmed early leader in a field lacking natural pace-setters. Merry Blacksmith, Royal County Glory and Caoilte may show some early interest but lack the style to sustain pressure on the leader. The sustainable pace will allow Venetian Star to dictate terms throughout, creating a tactical advantage for prominent racers and disadvantaging the numerous hold-up horses who need a strong gallop. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can track the pace closely.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian Star gets an easy lead and sustains his effort better than recent mile attempts.
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to control the race completely, with prominent racers unable to mount a serious challenge until too late. His early positioning proves decisive as the hold-up brigade struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory or Merry Blacksmith can track Venetian Star closely without over-racing.
scenarios.body: The tracker saves ground in behind the leader before striking in the final furlong, taking advantage of their tactical position while the leader tires. Hold-up horses again find themselves with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves slower than expected and Fortuity or One Cool Bear find clear racing room.
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed creates a sprint finish that suits horses with finishing kicks coming from off the pace. Shane Foley's tactical awareness on Fortuity becomes crucial in timing the challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Venetian Star stops quickly and multiple horses converge simultaneously in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with several runners hitting the line together, favouring those with the strongest recent form. Late-closing types benefit from the tactical collapse.

watchPoints.text: Venetian Star getting uncontested lead through early stages - becomes very hard to peg back
Merry Blacksmith and Royal County Glory over-racing when tracking the leader early
Fortuity and One Cool Bear getting clear runs in straight as hold-up horses need luck
Kc Bear's starting problems recurring given importance of early positioning
Weather conditions remaining stable as several runners switching from all-weather

races.name: Racing Again Next Friday Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Smithfield
runners_data.note: Prominent racer showing improved handicap form, well-backed last time and step up in trip should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Reappeared last month with best handicap effort (well-backed) yet in finishing fourth at Limerick over a mile, staying on; longer trip here could suit and one to consider.

runners_data.name: Perfect Judgement
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with AW wins but unproven over this distance on turf despite late headway last time
runners_data.spotlight: Four AW wins, sole turf win came at Leopardstown (7f); late headway into midfield on recent yard debut at latter venue, remains unproven over this far.

runners_data.name: Je Suis Celebre
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who was touched off over 7f at Kempton but both runs for new yard have disappointed
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo touched off in 7f Kempton novice in January before bought out of Ian Williams' yard for 41,000gns; both maiden runs for new yard a bit below that level and now steps up in trip (bred to stay) for handicap debut with new headgear combination tried.

runners_data.name: Shanlieve
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning after 236 days off, showed promise on good ground but may need this run
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise in 3yo maidens on good ground, softer conditions may not have suited on handicap debut in October; best watched on return.

runners_data.name: Guy's Girl
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse stepping back from 1m4f where she didn't stay, second handicap attempt at more suitable trip
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in maidens last year at 1m-1m1f; not sure she stayed 1m4f on latest, back in trip here on second handicap attempt.

runners_data.name: Bright N Shine
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with two wins at this trip but absent for 374 days, needs significant fitness improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins came at this trip, most recently at Down Royal in 2024 off 64 under today's rider; absent since moderate second in 2m Tramore handicap hurdle a year ago so may need this.

runners_data.name: Rising Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won at this trip at Dundalk, back down to workable handicap mark
runners_data.spotlight: Dundalk winner over this trip in March, her first success at the 15th attempt; faced tough task from out of the handicap at Musselburgh following month, back down in grade here.

runners_data.name: Hosanna Power
runners_data.note: Hold-up type trying cheekpieces for the first time, no win for two years and poor recent form
runners_data.spotlight: No win since 1m2f Newbury success two years ago; form this spring poor; handicapper quick to drop him but no improvement; cheekpieces now tried.

runners_data.name: She's Ideal
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who stayed this trip well when beaten a neck last time at Sligo
runners_data.spotlight: Returned with a couple of good runs, notably staying today's trip well when only beaten a neck at Sligo; didn't get home in more testing conditions at Cork nine days ago (cheekpieces tried but now discarded) but remains of interest back on better ground.

runners_data.name: Doctor Grace
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse coming off a 1m4f turf win under today's rider, 5lb penalty but in good form
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded third turf win earlier this month at Roscommon under positive ride from today's rider (1m4f, good), overcoming wide draw and having been hampered; 5lb rise takes her back to a near career-high mark so interesting to see if she can back that up.

runners_data.name: Casheldale Lass
runners_data.note: Prominent type with two handicap wins at this trip last year, back to form when just touched off last time
runners_data.spotlight: Won Gowran and Naas handicaps last year at around this trip and back to form at Leopardstown earlier this month, staying on well when just touched off over this trip; 2lb rise okay, should again be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Pebble Island
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest form for previous and current connections, down 10lb already this term
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form for the Crisfords and nothing so far for current connections under both codes; down 10lb already this term.

runners_data.name: Moyassr
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with strong AW record but 0-13 on turf, first attempt at this trip on grass
runners_data.spotlight: Boasts a fine AW record (4 wins) but continues to struggle on turf (0-13); first turf attempt at this trip.

runners_data.name: Proleek Prince
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who fades in finish, useful 2024 form but struggling this term, tries longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Useful form in 2024, winning over a mile at Punchestown and Dundalk; failed to prosper last year and lots to find on two efforts this term; tries this longer trip again.

runners_data.name: Out On Friday
runners_data.note: Only front-runner with eight career wins including twice at this course at 1m4f, fades in finish but ground suits
runners_data.spotlight: Eight career wins include twice here at 1m4f; probably needed recent Roscommon comeback run, more expected of here with ground in his favour.

runners_data.name: Anchors Away
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying tongue-tie on turf return after improved AW form, absent for 104 days
runners_data.spotlight: Much-improved when third in Dundalk AW maiden in January, following month well held on handicap debut over same C&D; tongue-tie fitted for turf return, others preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Out On Friday is the only confirmed front-runner in this 16-runner field, with several prominent racers like Smithfield, Shanlieve, She's Ideal, Casheldale Lass and Proleek Prince likely to sit handy but not challenge for the early lead. This creates a sustainable tempo with Out On Friday able to dictate from the front without early pressure, before the large pack of hold-up horses including Perfect Judgement, Je Suis Celebre, Guy's Girl, Bright N Shine, Rising Sky, Hosanna Power, Doctor Grace, Pebble Island, Moyassr and Anchors Away all converge in the final two furlongs. The lack of pace pressure early strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without having to use energy, while the hold-up brigade face a wall of traffic in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday gets an easy lead without early pressure from the prominent horses.
scenarios.body: Out On Friday controls the tempo completely and kicks clear in the straight before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. The veteran's stamina and course experience at this trip proves decisive when allowed to dictate terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers sits closer than expected and pounces late.
scenarios.body: Smithfield, She's Ideal or Casheldale Lass track the uncontested leader before striking with a well-timed challenge in the final furlong. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on the large group of hold-up horses who get caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the field bunches dramatically.
scenarios.body: The massive group of hold-up horses all arrive together in a cavalry charge finish with Perfect Judgement, Doctor Grace or Guy's Girl finding gaps. The lack of early pace allows them to get into contention but creates a messy, luck-dependent finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Out On Friday stops quickly due to his age and recent return from a break.
scenarios.body: The veteran leader fades dramatically in the final furlong allowing a prominent racer like Proleek Prince or an improving hold-up horse to sweep past. His known tendency to fade in the finish combines with fitness concerns after 374 days off.

watchPoints.text: Out On Friday's fitness after 374 days off could see him stop quickly in the final furlong despite getting an easy lead
Traffic problems are inevitable with 13+ hold-up horses all needing room in the straight from this large field
Apprentice jockeys on several fancied horses including Conor Cusack on Perfect Judgement and Rebecca Parsons on Shanlieve in a tactical race
Casheldale Lass and Doctor Grace both carry penalties from recent wins and need to overcome the extra weight
Several horses like Bright N Shine and Shanlieve are returning from long layoffs and may need the run fitness-wise

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Mandara Mist
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type with strong pedigree but unknown quantity making debut for powerful connections
runners_data.spotlight: Mehmas half-sister to winners Age Of Kings (6f 2yo/7f Group 3; RPR 113) and Dunamase (1m AW 2yo; 85); dam 1m-1m2f winner (inc 2yo Group 2; 110), half-sister to Australian 11.5f Group 3 winner Beyond Thankful; tongue-tied for debut, obvious respect from top yard.

runners_data.name: Mathoura
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning after 23 days with sustainable pace style and good course conditions record
runners_data.spotlight: Calyx filly a 30,000euros foal and 65,000euros yearling; half-sister to French winners Illois (9.5f/1m2f AW) and Imbleville (10.5f AW); dam 9.5f-10.7f winner (inc AW), out of half-sister to 1m2f BC Filly & Mare Turf winner Starine; good introduction in Gowran fillies' maiden early this month, plenty green when chasing home a potentially smart sort over 9.5f; definite player.

runners_data.name: Mai Dahlia
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner from strong stable with solid recent third and versatile trip range
runners_data.spotlight: Too Darn Hot half-sister to winners Ameerat Jumaira (Group-placed 10.6f-1m4f inc AW; RPR 99) and Jujubella (1m2f-12.4f inc AW; 78); dam unraced half-sister to UAE 1m2f Group 1 winner North America;  promising Naas debut 11 days ago, coming home strongly from off the pace, having not had a clear run, when beaten a head and neck in fillies' maiden over 1m; longer trip set to suit and could be the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Guardian Of Realm
runners_data.note: Hold-up type wearing hood again after being too keen over shorter trip, needs to settle better
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in all three starts in maidens at 7f-1m on the AW last year; hooded on recent Naas return but too keen and below best over a mile; upped in trip now with questions to answer and lots to find with Mai Dahlia on that run.

runners_data.name: Purely
runners_data.note: Prominent runner trying new distance after disappointing recent efforts, blinkered last time
runners_data.spotlight: Siyouni filly has looked fairly ordinary to-date, most recently when tried blinkered in good-class Leopardstown fillies' maiden last month; tries a new trip.

runners_data.name: Monamie
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with fading tendency who struggled badly on recent debut after slow start
runners_data.spotlight: Cotai Glory filly out of a Galileo mare who was a 1m4f winner; never recovered from a slow start on recent Roscommon debut (maiden claimer); best watched in a much stronger race here.

runners_data.name: Six Wings
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with poor recent form and fading tendency, needs significant improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way in maidens at Naas and Roscommon earlier this month; eligible for a mark after this.

races.paceDynamic: Mathoura will take this forward uncontested as the only confirmed front runner, with Purely likely to track her in second. The lack of early pace pressure means Mathoura can dictate a comfortable tempo through the early stages before the hold-up horses like Mai Dahlia, Guardian Of Realm, and Mandara Mist try to mount late challenges. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early, as the hold-up horses will need the pace to collapse to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Mathoura Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Mathoura gets the soft lead she expects without early pressure
scenarios.body: She can dictate fractions that suit her stamina and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still struggling to get into the race. The lack of pace pressure plays directly into her hands as the confirmed pace angle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian enough for closers to be effective
scenarios.body: Mai Dahlia or Mandara Mist can use their superior class to reel in the leaders who may have gone too slowly early. The trip increase suits Guardian Of Realm's style if he settles better.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Purely Improves Forward
scenarios.trigger: If Purely can secure a good position tracking Mathoura without doing too much work
scenarios.body: She can use her class edge over the field when the race develops, especially with the step up in trip potentially suiting better. The Ballydoyle filly has more scope than her recent form suggests.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Guardian Benefits Trip Rise
scenarios.trigger: If Guardian Of Realm settles much better over this longer distance
scenarios.body: The hood-wearing filly can use her all-weather form to advantage, particularly if she relaxes better over 1m2f than the mile that saw her too keen at Naas. The trip increase could unlock her potential.

watchPoints.text: Mathoura getting an uncontested lead could make her very hard to peg back with no other natural pace in this small field
Guardian Of Realm's settling ability under the hood as her keenness over shorter trips has been problematic
Mandara Mist's market support given her debut status but strong breeding connections
Purely's ability to handle the trip increase after looking held by shorter distances recently
The pace development early as only Mathoura shows natural speed which could create tactical issues
